Admin routes of the countries module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/countries

List countries with enabled/default flags

Responses:

- `200`: Countries retrieved.

## PATCH /v1/admin/countries

Bulk update enabled countries + default

Request body: [UpdateEnabledCountriesDto](#updateenabledcountriesdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Updated.
- `400`: Empty enabled list or default not in enabled set.

## Schemas

### UpdateEnabledCountriesDto

- `enabled` (`"QA"`, `"AE"`, `"SA"`, `"KW"`, `"BH"`, `"OM"`, `"EG"`, `"JO"`, `"LB"`, `"MA"`, `"LY"`, `"TN"`, `"GB"`, `"DE"`, `"FR"`, `"IT"`, `"ES"`, `"NL"`, `"SE"`, `"US"`, `"CA"`, `"MX"`, `"BR"`, `"IN"`, `"PK"`, `"ID"`, `"MY"`, `"SG"`, `"AU"`, `"JP"`, `"KR"`, required).
- `defaultCode` (`"QA"`, `"AE"`, `"SA"`, `"KW"`, `"BH"`, `"OM"`, `"EG"`, `"JO"`, `"LB"`, `"MA"`, `"LY"`, `"TN"`, `"GB"`, `"DE"`, `"FR"`, `"IT"`, `"ES"`, `"NL"`, `"SE"`, `"US"`, `"CA"`, `"MX"`, `"BR"`, `"IN"`, `"PK"`, `"ID"`, `"MY"`, `"SG"`, `"AU"`, `"JP"`, `"KR"`, optional).
